headings.usage: All section titles, hero headlines, and feature cards. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, buttons, and detailed text.

primary.name: Deep Red
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, borders, key highlights.

secondary.name: Navy Blue
secondary.usage: Headings, Footer background, Text accents, Navbar text.

background.usage: Main is pure white. Alt is for alternating sections to create rhythm.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or paper texture overlay on #F5F5F5 sections to avoid digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.gradients: NONE. Use solid colors or very subtle mesh gradients only if absolutely necessary for hero backgrounds (White to extremely pale blue).

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Section padding: py-20 or py-24. Element gaps: gap-8 or gap-12.

grid_system.bento_grid: Use for Infrastructure and Gallery. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 tiles.
grid_system.cards: Clean, white background, subtle border (border-gray-100), hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.

layout_strategies.mobile_rules: All grids collapse to 1 column. Tab switchers must be vertical stacked (Accordion style or Vertical Pills).

navbar.style: Sticky, White Background, Red Bottom Border (border-b-4 border-[#C0152A]).

buttons.primary: bg-[#C0152A] text-white hover:bg-[#a01223] px-8 py-3 rounded-md font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#1A2E6C] text-[#1A2E6C] hover:bg-[#1A2E6C] hover:text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-md font-medium

cards.feature: White bg, p-8, border-l-4 border-[#C0152A] hover:border-l-8 transition-all.

marquee.style: Pure CSS animation. Background: #1A2E6C. Text: White. Slow, smooth scroll.

stats_bar.style: Simple, Typography-focused. Large numbers in Red, labels in Navy.

hero_slides.alt: Students playing football on school grounds

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The theme is LIGHT ONLY. Do not use dark backgrounds for sections other than the Footer.
NAVIGATION: Use 'Playfair Display' for the brand name in the navbar. Links should be 'DM Sans'.
TICKER: Implement the announcement ticker using PURE CSS (keyframes translate-x). Do not use heavy libraries.
HERO: Use a library like 'react-slick' or 'framer-motion' for the slideshow. Ensure images have a subtle 'zoom-out' (Ken Burns) effect.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all Red (#C0152A) text is on White background. If using Red background, text must be White.
FORMS: Use Shadcn components for inputs but style them with a Red focus ring (ring-red-500) instead of the default black/blue.
MOBILE: The academic curriculum tabs must stack vertically on mobile screens. Do not use horizontal scrolling tabs.
ANTI-AI: Avoid 'Inter' font. Use the specified 'DM Sans' and 'Playfair Display'. Avoid 50% gray text; use Navy Blue for subheadings.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic AI-assistant emojis.
Interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialog, Select, Tabs).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layout structures (Grid, Flex).
